cohort: Women with one previous lower segment cesarean section for a non-recurrent cause, between 37 and 41 weeks of gestation, excluding those with classical cesarean section, multiple cesarean sections, severe wound infection, transverse lie, placenta previa, fetal macrosomia, or severe IUGR.
finding: 70% of women who underwent a trial of labor after one previous cesarean section for a non-recurrent cause achieved a vaginal birth.
